Automation: Rules reference · play automation in progress

You wait for a lantern to turn away, then move along the strip of darkness between its light and the next.

Rules

Action
Maneuver
Attribute
None — no roll
Target / range / shape
Self, with a concealed route.
Duration
Instant. Applied conditions follow their normal duration and decay.
Equipment / acquisition
No item needed unless named above.
Limits
Repeatable; pay the action and any stated costs each use.
Type
Skill

Move up to 2 squares through actual dimness or concealment without provoking. If you were Hidden and the whole route conceals you, remain Hidden. This does not hide you in an exposed square.
